subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 remove its closing reference to this issue and track its fs-safe hardlink cleanup separately?
rationale: The reported workspace and safe-bin failures are already fixed and shipped, but repository policy keeps an issue open while an open PR explicitly claims to close it; this PR's one-file scope is unrelated to those failures.

options.title: Retarget the PR
options.body: Remove this issue's closing reference, link the appropriate fs-safe tracker if one exists, and then close this issue as shipped-fixed.

options.title: Expand and prove scope
options.body: Keep the closing relationship only if the PR is expanded to address and prove the two agent-tools suites in addition to its fs-safe change.

recommendation.title: Retarget the PR
recommendation.body: Remove this issue's closing reference, link the appropriate fs-safe tracker if one exists, and then close this issue as shipped-fixed.
